note: The demo food truck behind shortlistpass.com/foodtrucks. Single source for the seed script (scripts/seed-low-tide-tacos.mjs) and for the sign on the lot, so the two always match. A made-up business, flagged is_demo in the app's database; nothing here is a real business.
name: Low Tide Tacos
headline: Tacos by the tide.
about: A demo truck from Shortlist Pass: a made-up page with a real menu, real weekly stops and working preorders, so you can see what your own page would do. Nothing here is a real business, and no real money moves.

menu.title: Birria Tacos
menu.description: Three tacos of slow-braised beef with melted cheese, and a cup of consomé for dipping.

menu.title: Street Corn
menu.description: Grilled corn on the cob with crema, cotija, chili and lime.

menu.title: Carne Asada Tacos
menu.description: Three tacos of grilled steak with onion, cilantro and salsa roja.

menu.title: Baja Fish Taco
menu.description: Crispy fish, purple cabbage, lime crema. Priced each.

menu.title: Birria Quesadilla
menu.description: Griddled tortilla, birria, stretchy cheese, consomé on the side.

menu.title: Al Pastor Burrito
menu.description: Marinated pork, pineapple, rice and beans, wrapped tight.

menu.title: Chips & Guac
menu.description: Fresh-fried chips with guacamole made this morning.

menu.title: Churros
